data.description: INFORMATIVE, NOT NORMATIVE for the recorded actions. What IS normative is the property: two runs from the same seed, against the same situation and profile, produce the same action. That property is what makes agent-driven simulation reproducible and therefore usable for research. The specific actions depend on the original's random generator, so a rebuild must demonstrate the property with its own cases rather than match these.
data.normative_property: same seed + same situation + same profile => same action
